content.title: About
content.content: NFS Diet is a zero‑calorie carbonated soft drink designed for weight‑conscious consumers who enjoy a light, refreshing taste. It contains water, natural lemon‑lime flavor, and artificial sweeteners (aspartame, sucralose) instead of sugar.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: NFS Diet was first launched in 2005 as a response to the growing demand for diet beverages.
Unlike regular sodas, NFS Diet contains no sugar; artificial sweeteners provide sweetness without raising blood glucose.
The NFS brand is known for bold advertising campaigns often featuring well‑known athletes.
The drink is calorie‑free yet retains the characteristic fizz of carbonated beverages.
Packaging is made from recyclable aluminum, reducing the product’s environmental footprint.

items.title: Zero calories
items.content: The lack of calories makes it suitable for weight‑management and calorie‑restricted diets.

items.title: Does not raise blood sugar
items.content: Artificial sweeteners have a negligible impact on glycemic index, important for diabetics.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Water content helps maintain proper fluid balance.

items.title: No fats
items.content: The drink contains no fats, supporting heart‑healthy eating patterns.

items.title: Vitamin C in some variants
items.content: Certain NFS Diet versions are fortified with vitamin C, which supports immune function.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Aspartame and sucralose may cause individual sensitivities in some people.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic pH can contribute to tooth enamel erosion with frequent consumption.

items.title: Carbonation
items.content: Excessive intake of carbonated drinks may lead to bloating and gas.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Flavorings may contain trace aromatic compounds that can trigger allergies.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve NFS Diet chilled, in moderate amounts. It can be used as a base for mocktails, mixed with fruit juices, or added to sports drinks.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 3–5 days.
